newsitem.title: CHINA: China says finds large oilfield in Xinjiang.
newsitem.headline: China says finds large oilfield in Xinjiang.

text.p: China's Xinjiang Oil Administration said it had found a new oilfield in its northwestern Xinjiang region, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
The field in Shaqiuhe, about 130 km from the Xinjiang regional capital, Urumqi, was the latest breakthrough in oil and gas exploration in the eastern Junggar Basin in Xinjiang.
The administration drilled a test well in the area in April, and high-quality petroleum associated with gas was found at a depth of about 1,805 metres, Xinhua said.
Tests of the gas proved the well was the first high-yield exploratory well found on China's mainland this year, and gas could be found in an area of 84 square km around the area, it said.
The area is one of the important oilfields in the east Junggar Basin, with geological reserves of about 100 million tonnes of oil, it said, but gave no more details
Several oilfields have been found in the eastern part of the basin, which has a total petroleum reserve of 200 million tonnes. The area turned out 2.12 million tonnes of crude last year.
